Shared semantic history (not owned by an individual controller)
|
`-- DefaultCanvasHistoryService
    |-- contexts: WeakMap<CanvasEditingContext, CanvasHistory>
    |   `-- CanvasHistory (one archive per openContext handle)
    |       `-- CanvasHistoryRecord
    |           |-- headId / baselineId / past[] / future[]
    |           |-- snapshots[id]: StoredCanvasSnapshot
    |           |   |-- document: composition, WITHOUT scene.contents
    |           |   |-- diagramBindings: content keys -> exact revision IDs
    |           |   `-- view + nodeOrigins + optional transactionId
    |           |-- diagramRevisions[id]: retained DiagramRevision records
    |           `-- canvasViews: named recordings outside undo-restored state
    |-- openContext(): isolate viewers; unreachable handles allow collection
    |-- append(context, document, canvas, correspondence): checkpoint archive
    |-- document(): composition + bindings + revisions -> resolved document
    |-- navigate(): restore archived document/view; reject linked transfers
    |-- forkContext() / adopt(): support copied and headless histories
    |-- prepareTransfer() / prepareTransferNavigation()
    |   `-- Linked cross-canvas transactions -> workspace-level undo/redo
    |-- persistenceChanges(context, cursor): incremental history records
    `-- -> diagramRevisionStore: createStoredDiagram() / reviseStoredDiagram()
        `-- Shared internal revisionRegistry; resolve immutable revisions by ID
